production_rule: A channel is production only when production_eligible is true, it has a published identifier, and every required gate is passed with retained acceptance evidence for the exact published artifact.

required_gates.requirement: verified publisher identity and policy attestations
production HTTPS MCP endpoint and completed domain verification
successful current MCP tool and skill scans
complete public listing metadata and legal/support URLs
five passing positive cases and three passing negative cases
reviewer test account, demo recording, and release notes
directory approval and owner-controlled publication
immutable reviewed Git ref designated as the stable channel
published package provenance and checksum
clean install and upgrade acceptance on each supported OS
downgrade, rollback, revocation, and second-device acceptance
documented support window and compatibility range
Chrome Web Store developer account and reviewed listing
single-purpose, permission, privacy, and limited-use declarations
store-managed installation and automatic update acceptance
published-version upgrade and rollback acceptance
clean device migration and revocation acceptance
Partner Center developer account and certified listing
complete purpose, permission, data-use, and privacy declarations
store-managed installation and automatic update acceptance
published-version upgrade and rollback acceptance
clean device migration and revocation acceptance

findings: MCP initialize reports serverInfo.version 0.1.0 instead of the packaged manifest version 0.2.0.
Windows rollback and restoration acceptance is open after plugin-cache backup failed with access denied.

compatibility.planned_support_policy: Once production support is established, it covers the current stable Codex plugin release only after promotion and the immediately previous promoted stable release. A published but unpromoted predecessor does not create a support entitlement.
compatibility.note: Windows 10 22H2 and Windows 11 are the owner-approved initial targets, not yet production support claims. The production range, supported operating systems, and support window remain unclaimed until the exact tagged installation, update, rollback, migration, and revocation acceptance is retained for each claimed operating system.
